skill.name: generating-product-photos
skill.description: Creates commercial product photography from a product image or URL. It supports studio, lifestyle, campaign, on-model, close-up, flat-lay, seasonal, infographic, creative, and floating compositions.
skill.summary: Plan and generate consistent commercial product images across ten photography modes.

content.value_statement: Generic image prompts often distort products and produce inconsistent campaign assets. This skill converts product references and briefs into structured commercial photography workflows.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes a supplied product image or URL before planning a shoot.
Routes briefs across ten modes, including studio, lifestyle, close-up, infographic, and floating shots.
Builds prompts with product fidelity, composition, lighting, optics, and exclusion guidance.
Selects image models according to layout, text, and fallback requirements.
Plans multi-image sets with consistent references, models, palettes, lighting, and camera direction.
limitations: Requires an available image-generation tool and configured provider.
Cannot guarantee exact labels, typography, materials, or geometry in generated outputs.
Does not build marketplace listing galleries or photograph non-product subjects.
Does not independently regenerate or evaluate billed outputs without user direction.

use_cases.title: Build Ecommerce Packshots
use_cases.description: Create clean studio images that preserve product shape, color, materials, and packaging details.

use_cases.title: Plan Campaign Image Sets
use_cases.description: Develop coordinated hero, lifestyle, close-up, and seasonal frames with a consistent visual direction.

use_cases.title: Produce Client Concepts
use_cases.description: Translate a client brief into production-ready compositions, lighting choices, crops, and image-generation prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Studio Packshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one studio packshot from this product image. Use a clean background and preserve the product exactly. Use the default aspect ratio.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a simple ecommerce product image.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Lifestyle Frame
prompt_templates.prompt: Place this product in a realistic setting for [buyer]. Show its correct use and preserve every visible product detail. Use [aspect ratio].
prompt_templates.scenario: A marketer needs a product shown in context.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Coordinated Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan [number] product images for [channel]. Include studio, lifestyle, and close-up frames. Keep the same palette, lighting, model, and reference image.
prompt_templates.scenario: A brand needs a consistent set for a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an Advanced Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign sequence for [product] aimed at [buyer]. Define each frame's purpose, mode, crop, lighting, props, continuity, and requested on-image text.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creative lead needs detailed art direction across several placements.

output_examples.input: Create a clean square packshot from this skincare bottle photo.
output_examples.output: A square studio image with the unchanged bottle centered on a continuous light background, accurate materials, controlled highlights, and a grounded shadow.

output_examples.input: Create three coordinated images for a premium coffee launch.
output: Hero frame with the package as the brightest subject and open space for approved copy.
Lifestyle frame showing the package in a credible morning setting.
Close-up frame emphasizing the package texture and finish.

output_examples.input: Show this watch floating above a dark surface.
output_examples.output: A floating product frame with the unchanged watch, visible underside, believable displaced shadow, restrained companion props, and a clear sense of height.

best_practices: Supply a clear product image and state which visible details must remain unchanged.
Specify the destination, aspect ratio, buyer, frame count, and any approved brand guidelines.
Approve a multi-frame plan before generation because each image may incur a separate charge.
anti_patterns: Do not request unsupported product actions or invent moving parts.
Do not replace visual direction with photographer, publication, or competitor names.
Do not regenerate a disappointing or pending result without explicit user approval.

faq.question: Do I need a product photo?
faq.answer: A product photo is strongly recommended because it anchors identity. Without one, provide a precise description of form, materials, finish, and moving parts.

faq.question: Which photography modes are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports studio, lifestyle, hero, on-model, close-up, flat-lay, seasonal, infographic, creative, and floating modes.

faq.question: Can it create several images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. It first plans a coordinated frame list, then keeps references, models, palettes, lighting, and camera direction consistent.

faq.question: Can it add text to an image?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the exact wording, hierarchy, placement, and letterform character. Generated text may still require correction.

faq.question: How does it choose an image model?
faq.answer: It uses the default model for most images, a layout-focused model for graphics, and a fallback model after refusals or repeated failures.

faq.question: Will it automatically retry a poor result?
faq.answer: No. It returns the result and explains possible issues. A new billed generation requires user direction.
